Aachen

Please help support the mission of New Advent and get the full contents of this website as an instant download.

The city of Aachen lies in a Prussian valley, surrounded by wooded heights, on the Wurm, a tributary of the Roer.

The city owes its origin to its salubrious springs which were already known in the time of the Romans.
